title: File:Doi Luang Chiang Dao - Chiangdao Wildlife Sanctuary.jpg
claims: The photograph shows a sunset ridge in Chiang Dao Wildlife Sanctuary: layered forested ridges in warm light, a rocky foreground with low shrubs, and the sharp limestone peaks of Doi Luang Chiang Dao on the right under sunbeams.

Commons titles the file Doi Luang Chiang Dao - Chiangdao Wildlife Sanctuary.jpg; the picture shows the mountain setting the 2026 route traverses below, not the race track, course markings, aid station, timing mat or race-day weather.

The author is Nuttasak; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2021-12-27 at 17:46:34; the original is 5,440 x 3,627 pixels and 11,028,942 bytes; the file page gives no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 133,429 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Nuttasak, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
